text: The merchant, now Chancellor Lü Buwei, ruled in his place, and the boy on the throne learned to watch and keep silent.
spoken: The merchant, now Chancellor Lew Boo-way, ruled in his place. And the boy on the throne learned to watch... and keep silent.
